verdict.rationale: Evidence only offers a vague marketing tagline ('Collaborate and iterate quickly with your team') with no detail on scene serialization format, diffability, merge tooling, or a named collaboration/VCS product; nothing describes mergeable scenes or text-based diff-friendly formats. Missing for 10: documentation of YAML/text scene serialization mode, a smart-merge tool for scenes/prefabs, and details of a built-in version-control/collaboration product (e.g. Unity VCS/Plastic) with independent corroboration.
